## Où j'en suis
The HubSpot owner + ARR sync was switched from webhooks to polling: PR #405 was closed after finding that private app tokens can't manage webhook subscriptions, and `daniel/hubspot-owner-sync` now holds a 15-minute CRM-search job with windowed paging past the 10k cap and an `arr > 0` filter. PR #409 is open, not merged — auto-merge was enabled but the e2e check `test_admin_accounts` fails, so it never fired.

- [en-cours] `test_accounts_table_shows_owner` expects 3 rows with an owner but gets 2: the e2e fixture's third company is a trial with an owner, now skipped by the `arr > 0` filter.
- [prochaine-étape] Fix that fixture (give the third company ARR > 0, or expect 2 rows) so the check goes green and auto-merge squashes #409; Noa still has to add `HUBSPOT_TOKEN` to Secrets Manager for staging/prod.
- [essai-raté] Registering webhook subscriptions via the API: 401, private app tokens aren't supported there, only public apps.
- [décision] Poll every 15 minutes instead of webhooks, and close #405 (source: t04)
- [décision] Sync only companies with arr > 0, trials excluded entirely (source: t10)
- [décision] Open the PR with auto-merge, token to be moved to Secrets Manager (source: t12)
